messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert — elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed in hosted-api-prod (region: eu-central-1). 5xx rate jumped to ~7.6% in 5m window. Paging oncall.
Lexi: I'm oncall. pulling dashboards now. Where's customer impact? :eyes:
Omar: Gateways are returning a mix of 429s and 502s. Looks like rate-limiter started rejecting a large chunk around 07:42 UTC. 5xx downstream follow.
Cheryl: Logs show a sharp uptick in downstream kv-cache timeouts and overloaded worker queues. Likely retry storm.
Dylan: Any recent quota/rate-limit changes? I can check deploy history.
Mike: I merged a quota policy change at 07:40 (PR #4488). It was intended to scope burst windows per-tenant but a templating mistake caused the scope to be empty -> resolves to GLOBAL.
Lexi: OK that's probably it. Can we immediately disable the new policy or add a temporary passthrough?
OD-Infra: We have admin endpoint for ratelimit mode. Recommend enabling passthrough and rolling the controller back. Passthrough should stop 429s to downstream.
infra-bot: Command issued: `kubectl -n gateway exec deploy/api-gateway -- /admin/ratelimit/set-mode passthrough --duration 15m` — response: 200, passthrough active.
Omar: After passthrough, 429s dropped ~65% in 45s and 502s trending down. Still seeing some backlog processing.
Jenn: Support: customers reporting increased latency and some failed requests. Holding broad notifications until containment but prepping targeted outreach for top impacted tenants.
Cheryl: Running quick query to map 429/5xx to tenants:

```
SELECT tenant_id, sum(case when status=429 then 1 else 0 end) as r429, sum(case when status>=500 then 1 else 0 end) as r5xx
FROM access_logs
WHERE ts > now() - interval '15 minutes'
GROUP BY tenant_id
ORDER BY r5xx DESC, r429 DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

Cheryl: Top hit tenants: enterprise-alpha, platform-inc, t-legacy-3. Mix of high-volume and a couple medium enterprise customers.
Mike: Root cause confirmed: env var `QUOTA_SCOPE` rendered empty in template -> defaults to GLOBAL. Fix: patch deploy template and rollback controller.
Lexi: Plan:
1) keep passthrough override active
2) rollback quota-controller to previous revision
3) add short tenant exceptions for enterprise-alpha/platform-inc while we validate
4) monitor errors/latency and update CS
Dylan: I'll add the tenant exceptions: `ratelimit exception add tenant=enterprise-alpha ttl=2h` and same for platform-inc.
infra-bot: Tenant exceptions applied. infra-bot: `kubectl -n infra rollout undo deployment/quota-controller --to-revision=4` (rollback started).
Omar: Note: client SDKs show retry logic without jitter in many cases — contributes to amplification. We should include guidance after.
Jenn: Sending targeted messages to enterprise-alpha and platform-inc, flagging followup with legal for enterprise contract language.
Cheryl: After rollback confirmed, controller reports QUOTA_SCOPE=TENANT. Passthrough removed after stable metrics at 07:58 per infra runbook.
infra-bot: Passthrough expiry triggered at 08:00: `ratelimit mode reverted to normal`.
Lexi: We're seeing 5xx back to baseline ~0.6% and 429s normalized. Good containment.
Mike: Adding pre-deploy CI check to validate scope variable is explicitly set to one of [TENANT, GLOBAL, SERVICE]. Will open PR and include a unit test.
Dylan: Also adding alert for sudden +X% change in ratelimit rejection rate and a config-drift alarm for env var changes on controller pods.
Cheryl: Preparing postmortem draft with timeline, logs, SQL outputs, and remediation steps. I'll link dashboards and include sample commands used during mitigation.
Jenn: Support follow-up: will send incident summary to impacted customers and offer a technical writeup once PMs/Legal review.
Lexi: Oncall handoff: staying on until 10:30 UTC. Mike, pls take over after that for monitoring window.
Mike: I can cover. Ping me for any regression.
Dylan: Action items captured:
- CI validation for QUOTA_SCOPE (owner: Mike)
- Client retry guidance / recommend jittered backoff (owner: Omar)
- Alerting for ratelimit spike & envvar drift (owner: Cheryl)
- Canary change process for quota policy (owner: OD-Infra)
Lexi: Incident severity downgraded to SEV3 — customer impact contained. Postmortem assigned to Cheryl + Mike. Jenn to handle customer comms.
omnibus-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315-058 created and linked to tickets: SRE-801, INFRA-559, PM-315.
Lexi: Closing thread for now — will monitor metrics for next 45 minutes. reactions: :white_check_mark: :party-parrot:
